invariant: Preserve and present truth through evidence; do not classify administrations or policies as better or worse.

statutory_authority: Clean Water Act / Federal Water Pollution Control Act
operative_mechanisms: amended the Clean Water Act and added the municipal and industrial stormwater framework reflected in section 402(p)
established section 319 direction and federal financial assistance for state nonpoint-source assessment and management programs
added Title VI authorizing capitalization grants for State Water Pollution Control Revolving Funds
formally established the National Estuary Program and authorized management conferences and comprehensive conservation and management planning

operative_mechanisms: established liability and compensation rules for oil-pollution removal costs and damages
strengthened federal oil-spill prevention and response authority
required response planning for vessels and certain facilities and supported Area Contingency Plans
provided the Oil Spill Liability Trust Fund for qualifying removal costs and damages
